[IDSP.13.4] **Value type mapping.** The engine must render `FN_JSON_VALUE`'s argument
as this table gives:

| DS value | JSON text |
|---|---|
| `null` | `null`: a `null` is stored, not refused ([LNUL.11.1]) |
| `Int` | a JSON number, the integer in decimal |
| `Float`, finite | a JSON number, in the canonical form of [LDET.3.2.7] |
| `Bool` | `true` or `false` |
| `String` | a JSON string: `"` and `\` escaped, `\n` `\r` `\t` for those three, `\u00XX` for any other character below U+0020, and every other character as itself |
| `Time` | a JSON number, the instant's UTC nanoseconds since the Unix epoch |
| `Date` | a JSON number, the days since 1970-01-01 |
| `Duration` | a JSON number, the nanoseconds |
| `Json` | the JSON text [LGRA.5.8.7a] gives the document |

**A value with no JSON form is refused.** A non-finite `Float`, a `Bytes` value,
a fact reference and a `Ratio` have none. For each, the engine must raise a
`ComputationError` of kind `NOT_REPRESENTABLE` ([LERR.1.4.9]) and abandon the
activation, so the `cache` write does not happen. It must not write a
placeholder, `null` included. A non-finite `Float` is also the hard error
[LDET.3.2.7] names for the JSON data plane.
